concerns.analysis: Multiple meaningful images from the source PDF fail to render in the HTML output due to missing image data. For example, on page 2 under the 'Authenticator' section, the images showing the Simeio Authenticator app icon, the smartphone scanning a QR code, and the successful enrollment popup are all missing. The image manifest indicates these have a base64 length of 0, and they appear in the HTML as empty comments.

concerns.description: List numbering restart(s): 11 ordered list(s) restart numbering at 1 instead of continuing sequence
concerns.analysis: restart_count=11. Examples: p2: list restarts at 1 (prev page 1 ended at 6); p2: 5 single-item ordered lists (fragmented); p3: list restarts at 1 (prev page 2 ended at 9). Ordered lists that restart numbering suggest content was split across page breaks and not reassembled.
